exposure: Severe/chronic illness when under 3 yr of age
cohort: 282 children aged 7-8 years old in urban areas of Khon Kaen, Thailand
finding: Cesarean section, complications during vaginal delivery, and poor health during the first 3 years of life are independent risk factors for MIH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be significantly associated with MIH (adjusted OR = 2.0, 95% CI = 1.1-3.7).
